dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: Hi everyone, my name is Gregor. Welcome to Genetics Town! I'm excited to show you around this place I call home.

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: This digital world is built using hundreds and hundreds of lines of code.

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: In Genetics Town, we'll explore another kind of code: genetic code.

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: Genetic code is also called DNA. It is found in all living things, which is why it's often known as the building block of life.

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: It is responsible for determining nearly every aspect of who you are - your appearance, your personality, and even how likely you are to get something as simple as a sunburn or as complex as an illness.

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: Every living thing has its own unique genetic code. It's what makes each of us different!

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: While you're in Genetics Town, you can use genetic code to create your own avatar. Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: Fantastic! Look at all the other avatars around you. They all have their own colors and features because of differences in their genetic sequences.

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: Have fun exploring by going up to other avatars and selecting "Hello" to discover their genetic sequences.

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: Try meeting as many avatars as possible, as friendship and knowledge are powerful. As you keep exploring, you'll discover why…

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: Let's learn this avatar's name and genetic code. But, learning can be tricky - it takes time and effort.

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: To learn this information and form a memory of the avatar, you must match a memory device on the top row with its partner on the bottom row, indicated by matching colors.

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: All colors will flash briefly, then disappear. It is up to you to remember the colors and create the correct match.

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: But be careful - only one set of memory devices will yield the correct learning. Matching any other set will result in a failed trial, as it will trigger the wrong response.

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: You must match the correct set 3 times to complete the game and fully unlock all information about the other avatar. Good luck!

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: Nice work! You've unlocked your friend's full genetic code, let's take a look!

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: When you're ready, you can click "Next" to reenter Genetics Town to meet more friends.

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: Attention everyone, no need to p-p-p-PANIC!!!

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: It looks like there's a bug! This bug has a genetic code of its own that's snuck into every avatar's genetic code.

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: We need your help to fix this! Figure out the bug's genetic code to find a cure and bring Genetics Town back to health. Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: To cure your avatar, first figure out the genetic sequence of the bug. To find the genetic sequence of the bug, look through the sequences of all the avatar friends you've made and find the 6 letters that are ordered the same in everyone's code.

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: Genetics Town is counting on you!

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: Now that you’ve found the genetic sequence of the bug, you can create a cure!

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: To cure the bug, we must stop it from creating harm. If we cover up, or silence, the bug’s code, then it can’t function.

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: This is how we can cure our avatars! This kind of cure is called an ASO.

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: To create an ASO, we must hide the letters in the bug’s genetic sequence with certain other letters. Specifically, we must hide an A with a T and a T with an A, or a C with a G and a G with a C.

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: Here, you will see the 6 letters in the bug sequence you’ve already found. Now it's time to create the ASO. We believe in you!

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: ASO is short for antisense oligonucleotide. It functions as a cure by working as a band-aid. It covers up, or silences, the harmful bug code, stopping it from damaging your avatar. ASOs are being studied to cure diseases in real life!

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: You saved Genetics Town! Now your avatar can continue exploring. Please play again to meet new friends by creating more avatars with their own genetic sequences. I hope you had fun visiting Genetics Town!

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: By interacting with [NAME], we will uncover the genetic sequences that make them unique! First, click on the avatar's four highlighted features to collect the needed DNA.

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: Great! Now, let's discover the genetic sequence that determines each selected feature. This process is called reading.

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: Once you begin your reading, you will see flashes of color in some order. Every color corresponds to a letter.

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: It is your job to translate all of the colors into their letters in the correct order. There will be four unique genetic sequences to translate, one for each feature.

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: Once all translations are finished, you will have unlocked the avatar's full genetic code.

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: This information will be stored in your inventory for safekeeping, to be used in case any trouble Genetics Town arises. Good luck!

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: Nice work! You've completed the full genetic sequence for your new friend. This information will be stored in your inventory.

dialogues.speaker: Gregor
dialogues.text: Now, click back into Genetics Town to make more friends and discover more sequences.
